svg.title: GPT-2's 768 numbers at END for one question ('My top up says it is still pending'): as they come, a few numbers in the tens and hundreds and the rest near 0; standardised over the 3,000 training questions, all on one scale; and the training loss of the same head on each, 3 seeds
svg.text: Over the 3,000 training questions most numbers vary by about 0.019; number 496 sits near 175.8 and varies by 3.66.
Standardised: each number less its mean there, over its spread there (center and spread, fixed before training).
